page0.text:
I should go check on her.
If Saber's right, then this is no time to worry about embarrassing myself.

page1.text:
"Sakura."
I call her name through the door.
There's no reply from the dressing room.
In fact, it doesn't even sound like anyone's inside.

page2.text:
"Sakura...? Hey, are you in there?"
I knock on the door.
Softly at first, then more vigorously, until I'm literally pounding on the door.

page3.text:
"Sakura! Hey, say something if you're in there!"
My anxiety turns into certainty.
Something's wrong.
I can't go in there, so maybe I should go get Fuji-nee or Saber to look in on her—

page4.text:
"Huh? O-oh, Senpai? Why are you so worked up?"
"S-Sakura!? Uh, it's nothing. You took a while, so I was wondering what happened."

page5.text:
"That's odd. Was I in there for such a long time?"
"...?"
Sakura sounds kind of hazy.
Like she's weak, or unsteady on her feet, or like she just woke up from a nap.

page6.text:
"Sakura... Don't tell me..."
"...Yes. It was very nice, so I took a short nap..."
"S-silly. Don't scare me like that, seriously."
I slowly sink to my knees.

page7.text:
"...I'm sorry. I'll be right out."
"You do that... You'll catch a cold if you sleep in the bath, you know."

page8.text:
I sigh and lean against the wall.
...I feel silly for being so worried, but I'm glad she's fine.
Sakura should feel better after a bath and a good night's sleep.

page9.text:
"What was that?"
I hear the sound of something heavy falling.
It definitely came from the other side of the door.

page10.text:
"Sakura!?"
She doesn't respond.
There isn't the feeling of someone on the other side of the door like there was earlier.

page11.text:
"Ngh! I'm coming in, Sakura!"
I run into the dressing room.
Sakura's lying on the ground, spiritless.

page12.text:
"Sakura! Sakura!"
I lift her limp body off the ground.
She's soft under my fingers, and warmer than I expected.

page13.text:
"Ah. Mm...ngh..."
Sakura doesn't seem conscious, but her breathing is labored.
Her hands are clutched to her chest, as if trying to pry off something stuck to her skin.

page14.text:
"Hah...ah...ah..."
Pained whimpers.
...This isn't eye candy.
The softness of her body I'm carrying, and her disheveled hair.
Wearing only a single shirt, this Sakura isn't the Sakura I know.

page15.text:
The shirt emphasizes her abundant chest, and I can't tear my eyes away.
Each heated sigh lifts her chest up and down, exposing her pearly neck.

page16.text:
...
My heart almost jumps into my throat.

page17.text:
"Ah...Mm, mm..."
Her distressed lips, seeking oxygen, make my head spin.
The body I'm holding is so hot, soft, and unbelievably charming.

page18.text:
My mind goes blank.
I'm not holding a girl in my arms, but a plenty matured woman.
This isn't the Sakura I know.
Then...if I let the dizziness take over and hold her close...

page19.text:
"Nngh! Damn it, what the hell is wrong with me!?"
I shake my head.
This isn't the time.
Sakura's fever isn't normal.
Above all, her fingers clutching painfully at her chest show that this is more than simple anemia.

page20.text:
"Sakura! Get it together, Sakura!"
I yell into her ear.
"Ah...Huah..."
The hair stuck to her cheek falls free.
Sakura slowly blinks her eyes open and looks up at me.

page21.text:
"Huh? Senpai...? What are you doing here...?"
"Idiot, should you really be asking that!? You should have told me if you had a fever!"
"Eh...? I have...a fever?"

page22.text:
"Who else would I be talking about!? Just touch your forehead! It's really hot!"
"Huh...but it doesn't feel that warm to me..."
Sakura murmurs dreamily. Maybe she's still half-asleep.

page23.text:
"Just...just stay still! I'll take you to your bed!"
"Kyah!? Senpai, what are you doing!?"
"Taking you to your room. Lemme warn you now, don't make a fuss. I'm not sure I can hold it together anymore."
I go into the hallway, carrying Sakura.

page24.text:
"Wah...! S-S-Senpai, you're carrying me!?"
Sakura wraps her arms tightly around my neck in surprise.

page25.text:
"Mngh."
Her ch-chest is incredibly bouncy and touching me but I'm going to ignore that right now!

page26.text:
Speed is of the essence.
Before my sanity gives out, I need to carry Sakura to the guestroom as fast as I can!

page27.text:
"Your fever's a tad over 37 degrees. Huh. That's lower than I expected."
I shake the thermometer and look at Sakura, who's lying in bed.

page28.text:
"I'm sorry... I must have gotten dizzy after getting into the bath in such a nervous state."
Sakura guiltily hides her face under the covers.

page29.text:
"Well, there's no helping the fact that you're sick. A cold like this should heal with medicine and some rest, so try and take it easy for tonight.
I'll leave water on this chair. Try not to go outside, all right? You'll get a chill."
Just in case, I put on another blanket over her and turn off the lights.

page30.text:
"See ya tomorrow. I'll come wake you up, so take it easy."
I give Sakura an affectionate pat on the head and make for the door.
But then...
Something tugs on me from behind.
"Hm?"
When I turn to look, there's something clutching my shirt sleeve.

page31.text:
"Sakura...? Sorry, I can't leave because you're holding on to me."
"Huh?"
Sakura withdraws her hand in surprise, as if she just noticed.

page32.text:
"I-I'm so sorry, Senpai! I must be dizzy from the fever, and...!"
Sakura jumps out of bed and frantically apologizes.
I can tell how red her face is even with the lights off.

page33.text:
"Sakura, are you scared?"
"...Yes. I'm afraid of sleeping alone in a place I don't know."
I can't see Sakura's expression. Her long hair hides her face.
...But from the side, her profile reminds me of that withdrawn girl I first met years ago.

page34.text:
"...I see. You must feel anxious, catching a cold and then using someone else's room for the first time."
I sit down on the bed.
Then, I lie down on my back.
I can't quite bring myself to face Sakura while doing it, but this is good enough.

page35.text:
"U-um, Senpai?"
"I'll stay a little longer. That'll help you get used to the room. I'll leave once you fall asleep.
To be honest, I'm worried you're forcing yourself to do this. I'll keep an eye on you for another thirty minutes, so lie back down."
I gesture to her spot on the bed without facing her.

page36.text: "...All right. Then please stay with me a while longer, Senpai."

page37.text:
A soft breeze caresses my cheek.
It must be the air displaced by Sakura pulling the covers back on.
...I consider this a small price to pay for her peace of mind.
It doesn't even begin to cover the interest on the debt I owe her for helping me so much.

page38.text:
...
...
In the dark, all one can hear is the ticking of the clock.
Whether it's because my back is to her, or because her profile is still in my mind,
the feelings I had when I carried her earlier fade, and I quietly stare at the clock.
...The rest of the time passes in silence, and anyone would guess that we'd both fallen asleep.

page39.text:
"Senpai, are you awake?"
I hear a gentle voice in the darkness.

page40.text:
"Mm."
I murmur an affirmative.
Sakura takes a quiet breath, and continues.
"...Okay. Thank you for today."
Then, she drifts off to sleep.
